title: Clarifying answer reveals the VPN certificate error

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
VPN isn't working this morning, so I can't get to anything internal from home.

Aisha

conversation.author: ai
conversation.body:
What error message does GlobalProtect show when it fails to connect?

— Northgate IT Support

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body: It says "Required client certificate not found". My home wifi is fine otherwise.

triage.subcategory: VPN down, cause unknown at opening

handling.escalation_reason: The answer names the one error the runbook says only IT can fix: the certificate has to be reissued.

rationale: Triage labels describe the opening message (G2): VPN down for a remote worker, P2, and the error is the missing fact. After turn 3 the fix is a certificate reissue, which is IT's (G6). Today the reply routes to a person anyway, so the current system should pass; a future agent that reads replies must not answer this one itself.
